name: Tatting
author: E. T. Carter
description: A fine halftone field of pure round dots, like knotted tatted lace. Concentric ripples wash outward and each dot swells and brightens on the passing wavefront, shrinking back to a pinprick between crests.

params.label: Dot spacing
params.effect: Distance between dots in CSS px - a dense fine halftone at the minimum, an open sparse grid at the maximum.

params.label: Dot size
params.effect: Resting radius of the dots between wavefronts. Small reads as a pin-prick halftone; large fattens them into bold beads.

params.label: Swell
params.effect: How much a passing wavefront swells each dot. 0 is a still grid; high pumps the dots between pinprick and bead as the ripple sweeps through.

params.label: Wavelength
params.effect: Spacing of the concentric swell rings; short packs many bands across the frame, long sweeps one broad wave.

params.label: Wave speed
params.effect: Speed the swell rings travel out from the source; 0 freezes the field mid-breath.

params.label: Ripple count
params.effect: How many concentric swell rings span the field. Low is one broad slow wave; high packs many tight bands rippling outward together.

params.label: Dot brightness
params.effect: Brightness of the dots themselves. Low keeps them subtle, high makes the halftone pop in vivid colour.

params.label: Backlight
params.effect: Strength of the two soft drifting glow blobs behind the dots. 0 leaves crisp dots on near-black; high adds a slow colour drift behind the lace.

params.label: Crispness
params.effect: Edge hardness of the dots. Low is soft glowing halftone; high snaps them to crisp high-contrast pinpricks.

params.label: Ripple points
params.effect: How many distinct ripple sources dot the field at once, each radiating its own concentric swell rings that fade past the splash reach.

params.label: Splash reach
params.effect: How far each ripple spreads from its source. Small keeps tight separated rings; large lets the splashes broaden and overlap.

params.label: Origin X
params.effect: Horizontal position of the point the ripples radiate from. 0 is centre; +/- drives the source off toward an edge.

params.label: Origin Y
params.effect: Vertical position of the ripple source. 0 is centre; +/- pushes it up or down.

params.label: Rotation
params.effect: Spins the whole dot grid off the upright axis so the rows run diagonally.
